Tamil Nadu Politics: Allegations of Horse-Trading and Arrests

Political parties in Tamil Nadu have accused each other of horse-trading. One party alleges attempts to lure legislators with ₹35 crore, leading to three arrests. The situation highlights ongoing political maneuvering and allegations of corruption within the state's political landscape.
